convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for XDerivative indicator and includes external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Signal logic depends on custom indicator buffer values.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timing
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Oppposite signal closes position: when XDerivative[1]>XDerivative[2] (derivative turning down), close buy; when XDerivative[1]<XDerivative[2] (derivative turning up), close sell

MMMode_options: LOSSFREEMARGIN=2: fraction of free margin minus loss
LOSSBALANCE=3: fraction of balance minus loss

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=MM as fraction (0.1=10%) of respective margin base

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic is two-tiered: (1) XDerivative[1]<XDerivative[2] means derivative is decreasing (uptrend weakening), and if XDerivative[0]>XDerivative[1] (current bar value rising above previous), trigger BUY. (2) XDerivative[1]>XDerivative[2] means derivative is increasing, and if XDerivative[0]<XDerivative[1] (current bar value falling below previous), trigger SELL. This is a momentum-derivative strategy detecting inflection points. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on bar[1] (last completed bar). Close signals fire on derivative direction change regardless of BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input gates. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that enable/disable each signal type. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup. LoadHistory is called to ensure bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: The XDerivative custom indicator must be ported first - it uses JJMA smoothing from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library contains 9+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA plus standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with money management. All 5 MarginMode sizing variants must be implemented. Signal logic reads 3 consecutive values from XDerivative buffer[0,1,2] relative to SignalBar=1, so effectively bars [1],[2],[3]. Entry/exit are gated by 4 boolean inputs. Deviation is used as slippage tolerance in points.
